payload.name: SMS reminder provider migrated to Sinch (Vonage out)
payload.body:
Summary: Move SMS reminders from Vonage to Sinch effective 2026-11-01.
Rationale: Vonage is failing on Portuguese numbers; Sinch is expected to deliver higher deliverability.
Impact: All SMS reminders will be routed via Sinch starting 2026-11-01. Vonage will be decommissioned.
Notes: This decision supersedes the previous SMS reminder provider decision (external reference: 28e16715-b34d-4570-95dd-b363bd47fd5a).

payload.reason: Response to 2026-10-14 message about analytics hosting.
payload.name: Switch product analytics to PostHog Cloud (EU region)
payload.body:
Summary: Switch product analytics from PostHog self-hosted to PostHog Cloud in the EU region.
Rationale: Self-hosted setup is costly in ops time; Cloud reduces maintenance burden while keeping data within the EU.
Impact: Analytics now hosted in PostHog Cloud EU; migration plan TBD.
Notes: This supersedes the previous decision: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted (id f004a28a...).

payload.name: Ship twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays behind feature flags
payload.body: Summary: Adopt a twice-weekly release cadence on Tuesdays and Thursdays, behind feature flags.\nRationale: Reduces mid-day disruptiveness and aligns with pilot clinic operations.\nImpact: Releases Tue/Thu; feature flags used to gate rollout.

payload.name: Concierge onboarding live; onboarding rollout completed
payload.body: Summary: Concierge onboarding is live for all pilot clinics and onboarding rollout task is marked as done.\nRationale: Onboarding content ready; clinics can begin onboarding flows.\nImpact: Concierge onboarding active; rollout complete.

payload.name: Dark mode for day view is in beta
payload.body: Summary: Dark mode for the day view is in beta.\nRationale: User experience improvement; collect feedback before wider rollout.\nImpact: Beta feature; measure adoption and issues.

payload.name: Investor updates monthly; keep metrics dashboard link
payload.body: Summary: Investor updates return to a monthly cadence; maintain the metrics dashboard link.\nRationale: Align communications with expectations; dashboard remains accessible.\nImpact: Monthly investor updates; dashboard link retained.

payload.name: Replace Tailwind UI kit with shadcn/ui as design system
payload.body: Summary: Replace Tailwind UI kit with shadcn/ui as the design system across Fernwork.\nRationale: Standardize UI with modern components; align with frontend direction.\nImpact: All UI should migrate to shadcn/ui; Tailwind UI kit deprecated.
